subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose update execution over a gateway-authenticated HTTP surface for fleet tools, and if so should that be a dedicated `/admin/update` contract or an allowlisted Admin HTTP RPC wrapper around `update.run`?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested endpoint would give network callers host package-update and restart authority while the current trusted Admin HTTP RPC surface deliberately omits `update.run`.

options.title: Defer HTTP update authority
options.body: Keep version metadata discussion in the narrow tracker and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

options.title: Expose through Admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Allow or wrap `update.run` only on the default-off Admin HTTP RPC surface with explicit private-ingress, auth, audit, rate-limit, handoff, and failure-mode documentation and tests.

options.title: Reject HTTP update execution
options.body: Keep update execution limited to CLI/WebSocket/control-plane paths and document that fleet tools should use those surfaces or an external orchestrator.

recommendation.title: Defer HTTP update authority
recommendation.body: Keep version metadata discussion in the narrow tracker and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest routing match across Admin HTTP RPC, Gateway HTTP security docs, update docs, and version helper history.
